name: ccfa-skills
description: CCFA CCF paper-project workflow skill family.

interface.longDescription: A governed 17-skill ccf-* family for CCF/NeurIPS paper projects, led by a humanization preflight for direct academic prose, warning isolation, efficient smoke scope, and confirmed full publication methods, followed by idea, evidence, visuals, writing, review, submission, and rebuttal owners.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ccf-humanization first for manuscript or publication-facing experiment artifacts, then use the appropriate canonical ccf-* owner. Keep warnings outside files and preserve material evidence.
